subject: Important Update Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear valued customer, we wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in processing your recent order due to unexpected inventory issues. Our team is working diligently to resolve this matter and expedite the delivery of your purchase. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience and understanding. Rest assured, we are committed to ensuring your satisfaction. Thank you for choosing our services.
